per_candidate.id: s2:The flux variability in persistent radio sources of fast radio bursts, 2025-02-01
s2:Long-term Monitoring of the Repeating Fast Radio Burst 20220912A with the uGMRT , 2026-09-07

rationale: The paper 2503.12452 directly investigates the lack of counterparts in other frequency bands by searching for X-ray counterparts to FRBs, but finds no credible evidence, thus posing the question as open. No other candidates provide substantive new evidence on the potential extragalactic sources of FRBs.
